headline: AFP Drone Systems Enter Testing as Military Eyes Integration
seoTitle: AFP Drone Systems Enter Testing, Integration Eyed
seoDescription: AFP chief Gen. Antonio Nafarrete said drone systems are being tested as the military works toward integrating unmanned capabilities across its services.
deck: AFP chief Gen. Antonio Nafarrete said drone systems are under testing as the military works toward integrating unmanned capabilities across its services.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Armed Forces of the Philippines is testing drone systems and studying how to integrate unmanned capabilities being developed across the military services, AFP chief Gen. Antonio Nafarrete said Thursday.

Nafarrete disclosed the progress during his confirmation hearing, according to the Philippine News Agency. The report described the work as an effort to bring together systems being developed by different services rather than as a completed operational deployment.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The AFP has been adapting doctrine and modernization priorities as drones become more prominent in surveillance and combat operations. Nafarrete has also emphasized integrated capability development, in which platforms are paired with trained personnel, doctrine, organization, logistics and long-term sustainment.
The accessible public record supports the testing and integration effort. It does not disclose classified ranges, payloads, production quantities or deployment locations.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: A coordinated approach could help the AFP avoid fragmented systems and improve interoperability among service branches. For the Philippines, unmanned capabilities may support territorial awareness and force protection, but their effectiveness will depend on testing, doctrine, training and sustainment.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for AFP disclosures on which systems complete evaluation, how common standards will be applied across the services, and whether tested platforms move into procurement or operational use.
